questions.prompt: Last weekend we ___ to the beach.
questions.explanation: 'Go' is irregular. The past simple is 'went'.

wrongReasons.0: 'go' is the base form. 'Last weekend' needs the past.
wrongReasons.2: 'gone' is a past participle and needs have/has.

questions.explanation: Use be + going to + base verb for plans: I am going to visit.

wrongReasons.2: 'go to' alone does not show a future plan.
wrongReasons.3: After 'will' use the base verb: will visit.

questions.prompt: She ___ TV when the phone rang.
questions.explanation: Use the past continuous (was/were + -ing) for an action in progress when something else happened.

wrongReasons.0: The past simple does not show that the action was in progress.
